officialTitle: Zero-trust harnesses for agentic software delivery

chapters.title: Introduction: what coding agents can and cannot do
Software delivery starts with shared intent
Review implementation plans before pull requests
Pair models and move review into the build
Keeping a mental model of the system
Exploratory testing and the test pyramid
Post-deployment monitoring across the whole system
Persistent agents and feedback into the next plan
The complete delivery and verification loop

existingSummary: Ohans Emmanuel walks through a connected software-delivery workflow: shared intent, implementation-plan review, paired models, visual system understanding, independent QA and production feedback that informs the next change.
